title: Run sealed independent attempts and build the complete cross-candidate check matrix
goal: Obtain genuinely independent candidate implementations and comparable evidence by running every hidden and producer-supplied test against every candidate.
scope: Implement IndependentAttempts(k) execution from one target snapshot, k isolated workspaces and distinct eligible producers of comparable strength, from different families when available. Validate k, available team, budget, attempt and parallel limits before and during admission.

Create sealed solicitations/window with criteria, own context and visible checks only; hide other participants’ results/tests/Board entries until all candidates are submitted or the deadline passes. Hidden checks themselves remain excluded from producer context after disclosure.

Require each Produce contribution to submit its own tests T_i with the candidate. Persist submitted/missing/failed/abandoned attempts and costs; do not manufacture a candidate or tests for a timed-out participant.

After window closure build and execute the complete matrix of H ∪ all T_i against every submitted cand_j on their immutable snapshots. Bind each cell to exact test/result/environment/role and retain Pass/Fail/Error/missing distinctions for selection.
acceptance: Two different real Scripted candidate processes submit implementations and tests independently; before closure neither can read the other’s context/results/tests/Board entries through native access or projections.

All-hidden plus all-producer-tests matrix contains a recorded result for every applicable candidate/test pair. An intentionally selective/missing cell cannot masquerade as a pass; test/result digest changes invalidate that cell.

Submission/deadline races close the window once, preserve partial candidates and spent cost, and expose which attempt failed to submit. Restart resumes/reuses recorded work without duplicate production or leaking hidden checks.
context: Authority: ymp-docs/self-organizing-team-domain-model.md, sections 3.3 (IndependentAttempts), 3.4 (Attempt), P7, A10, R-4/R-8/R-10/R-16. Use the approved model with 811a872 semantics and the greenfield baseline in 0c61ff1 and §5.8 for experimental strategy boundaries. Other documents and existing names explain implementation facts only.

Greenfield: create this behavior in the new implementation. Paths below are PROPOSED target modules under the layout owned by W1-0001; only completed prerequisite tasks supply implementation. Prior source, APIs, fixtures and delivery claims are not a baseline.

Create independent-attempt scheduling in proposed runtime/attempts.rs over W4-0001 workspaces, W2 checks, and W3 offers/profile/context protocols. Qualified experience arrives in W5; use explicit neutral/unknown strength facts for this wave.

Each candidate supplies real tests T_i and remains isolated until P7 submission/deadline closure. The full H ∪ all T_i matrix is substantive verification on immutable snapshots. Producer tests keep their authored independence and do not become Trusted merely by cross-execution.

W4-0003 selects the winner. This task’s output is durable independent candidates and a complete attributable matrix, including errors/missing submissions and all costs; it does not choose by confidence or arrival order.
